subject: Regional SKU choreography for Q3 deal slate
messages:
From: Aarav Sharma <aarav@helio.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: geo SKU choreography for Helio Q3 commitment

Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Helio's execs cleared a preliminary Q3 commitment and procurement asked me to get a region-by-region SKU and node plan so we can finalize SOW and capex timing. High level: 6-9 month committed ramp, target steady-state throughput ~5M tokens/min globally, but distribution is skewed: 55% US, 25% EU, 20% APAC.

Key asks for Redwood:
- Per-region sustained node counts for H100-equivalent work and an A100 fallback lane (we may accept mixed quantization).
- Expected latency SLO impact per region for 16k seq LLM chat at p95.
- Proposed buffer/burst lanes and how you’d handle failover between regions.
- Pinpoint any constraints that would push this into a dedicated pool commit vs reserved burst capacity.

I've attached our rolling forecast (helio_forecast_Q3.xlsx). Can we get a draft SKU choreography matrix by Friday 3/31? Procurement needs it for budget signoff.

—Aarav
Aarav Sharma
Head of Platform Partnerships, Helio AI
[attachment: helio_forecast_Q3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aarav Sharma <aarav@helio.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geo SKU choreography for Helio Q3 commitment

Aarav — thanks, and congrats to your team on the internal approval. We can definitely produce the SKU matrix. Quick clarifying Qs before we lock numbers:
1) The 5M tokens/min is global steady-state — do you expect reads (generation) to be evenly distributed across models or concentrated on a single large chat model?
2) What percent of traffic needs the 16k context window vs 4k? That materially changes H100 vs A100 sizing.
3) Any hard residency or data-flow constraints for EU/APAC (e.g., must keep inference inside EU for certain customer types)?

Proposed next steps: I’ll draft a regional choreography that includes a committed H100 pool for US with A100 fallback in EU, and an APAC micro-pool proposal (Singapore pilot) that uses burst-linked capacity for the first 90 days. Vanessa and Rishi — can you join a 30-min cadence tomorrow to review the initial draft?

I’ll attach the internal SKU matrix and a first-pass latency estimate after that meeting.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Draft regional choreography (notes prior to call)

Team — summary notes from my read of Helio forecast and initial sizing logic (I’ll bring these to the 9:00 AM sync):

- Assumptions pulled from helio_forecast_Q3.xlsx: steady-state 5M tokens/min global; 55% US, 25% EU, 20% APAC. Peak concurrency ~3x baseline for 4-hour windows. 60% of calls require 16k context; 40% are 4k.

- High-level SKU choreography proposal (first pass):
  * US: Committed H100 pool sized for ~2.75M tokens/min steady-state (p95 latency target 300-350ms for 16k sequences with batching heuristics). Buffer: +20% burst cushion (can be reserved or on-demand depending on SOW).
  * EU: Hybrid approach — reserved A100-heavy pool sized for 1.0M tokens/min with automatic fallover to US H100 for latency-sensitive premium accounts. EU residency note: GDPR-sensitive tenants will stay in EU and require dedicated nodes; call out as add-on.
  * APAC (Singapore pilot): Start with small dedicated node set (equivalent 0.4M tokens/min) + pre-wired burst lanes from our APAC cloud partner. After 60 days, evaluate bump to a committed micro-pool if utilization > 60% sustained.

- Quantization and model variants: Recommend mixed mode — FP16 H100 for p95-sensitive traffic, int8 A100 variants for cost-tier traffic. We should include model-level pinning options in the SOW so Helio can direct premium traffic to H100.

- Risks / procurement hooks: lead time for H100 provisioning in APAC is 8-10 weeks; if Helio needs APAC steady-state by July, they must commit by mid-April. Also need a clause for burst fallback pricing if cross-region failover is used regularly.

Attachments for the call: neha_regional_sku_matrix_v1.xlsx (first-pass numbers), short deck with latency sim notes. I’ll share the matrix in the thread after the call.

-Neha

From: Aarav Sharma <aarav@helio.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helio.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geo SKU choreography for Helio Q3 commitment

Neha — this is very helpful. Answers inline and attached updated forecast:

- Model distribution: ~70% of load hits our single production chat model (16k), remainder are embedding/rerank (4k).
- Residency: yes — EU customers in our EU tier must keep inference within EU region (GDPR). APAC has no hard residency constraints but prefers lower latency.
- Timing: target commercial go-live for pilot customers in APAC by 15 July.

We’ve attached an updated forecast that adds a 25% higher peak for one-week sustained marketing surge in mid-August. Also included list of enterprise accounts that require EU residency.

Let us know if you need a firm commitment date — procurement is trying to correlate with their budget approval on 4/15.

—Aarav
[attachment: helio_forecast_Q3_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aarav Sharma <aarav@helio.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, procurement@helio.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geo SKU choreography for Helio Q3 commitment — draft matrix and next steps

Aarav / team — attaching the matrix and a short decision checklist. Summary and proposed asks for procurement: 

1) Committed items to include in SOW: US H100 baseline (equivalent to 18 H100 nodes, see matrix row US-H100-committed), EU A100 reserved slab (12 A100 nodes) with model-pin fallbacks, APAC micro-commit (4 H100-equivalent nodes) + 30-day burst lane (pre-negotiated).
2) Timing ask: to meet 15 Jul APAC pilot we need signed SOW by 15 Apr (8-10 week provisioning window for APAC H100-equivalent). If procurement cannot commit by 4/15, we will offer a staged alternative (90-day burst overlay + expedited provisioning fee).
3) Pricing note: Mixed quantization mix yields estimated unit cost savings ~22% vs all-H100 baseline; include quantization opt-in in SOW.

Attachments: neha_regional_sku_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_helio_choreography_checklist.pdf (one-pager).

Next steps: 1) Procurement to confirm a target signature date (4/15 preferred). 2) If confirmed, we’ll produce a formal SOW and draft provisioning timeline and lane-by-lane fallbacks. 3) Vanessa to coordinate with Infra for exact lead-time confirmation and Rishi to prepare an A/B pricing appendix.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
